parameters.name: ChildInstanceId
parameters.description: The child instance ID. You must specify at least one of ChildInstanceId and TaskId. If both are empty, the error MissingParameter.TaskId (-360448) is returned.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The task ID. You must specify at least one of TaskId and ChildInstanceId. If both are empty, the error MissingParameter.TaskId (-360448, At least one of TaskId or ChildInstanceId is required.) is returned.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The type of the task. Valid values:

- **NAT**: NAT firewall task

- **VPC**: VPC firewall task
